section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 7. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 403 | 750 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 475 | 750 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
